To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

immortalization with the c-myc T-58A mutant is a safe and reliable approach to generate immortalized neural stem cells endowed with high proliferative capacity and the ability to generate oligodendroglia.

1) we have generated a novel and continuous line of human immortal neural stem cells (T-IhNC) in which the immortalization is due to a single and well-characterized c-myc mutation (T58A); 2) the T-IhNCs display a high propensity to generate human oligdendrocytes; 3) the T-IhsNCs are non-transformed and non-tumorigenic in vivo

we generated a new immortalized human neural stem cell line (T58A-IhNSC), which is endowed with a higher proliferative capacity and with the ability to generate human oligodenocytes, without altering their differentiation potential and functional properties.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a novel, safe and efficient tool for the study of the mechanisms of human neural stem cells self-renewal and for the development of novel approaches for the treatment of demyelinating disorders.
the development of immortalized human neural stem cells, endowed with a high proliferative capacity, while retaining the basic properties of human neural stem cells.

the establishment of a new immortalized human neural stem cell line, in which the safety of the immortalizing agent can be easily and directly assessed, and with the identification of a novel cell source for the generation of human oligodengrocytes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

immortalization of human neural stem cells by c-myc-T58A is a safe and effective approach to generate a cell line endowed with enhanced self-renewing capacity, which preserves its multipotent nature and is able to generate functional oligodendroglial cells.
T-IhNSCS represent a safe and reliable tool for the study of the mechanisms of human neural cell development.

immortalization of hMSCs by the c-myc T59A mutant represents a safe and efficient approach to obtain an immortalized cell line of human neural stem cells, which can be exploited for a wide range of experimental applications, without altering their functional and physiological properties.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the immortalization of human neural stem cells with c-myc T-58A generates a cell line endowed with a remarkable self-renewal capacity and a high propensity to generate human oligo-dendrocytes, which, however, do not display tumorigenic properties in vivo.

the T58A mutation of c-myc gene is sufficient to immortalize human neural stem cells without affecting their differentiation potential, their functional properties, their growth factor dependence and, most importantly, their tumorigenicity.
T-IhNSCS represent a novel and safe model for the study of human neural stem cells biology.
The main takeaway from our work is that
T-IhNSCS represent a safe and versatile tool that can be used in the study of human neural stem cell biology and in cell replacement therapies for neurological conditions.

the use of a c-myc mutant, devoid of any recombination elements, to immortalize hNSCs is a safe and effective approach to increase the proliferative capacity of hNSC in culture, without compromising their multipotent and functional properties.
the c-myc T-58A mutant is a safe and efficient tool for the generation of immortalized human stem cells.
